summary_1line: Lists karmic rebirths for various thefts and crimes, then begins teaching how repentance and charity—especially giving food—lead to purification and righteous outcomes.

image_candidates.scene_text: A condemned soul cycles through forms—ass, deer, fish, and leopard—each dying violently before regaining human birth.
A thief reborn as a mole burrows alone in dark earth, living out years of karmic punishment.
Yudhishthira sits before the sage Vrihaspati asking how sinners may reach heaven through repentance and gifts.
